title: Systemic cardiac microcoil migration: A rare complication of CT-guided lung localization

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Systemic cardiac microcoil migration: A rare complication of CT-guided lung localization》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】CT-guided microcoil localization facilitates minimally invasive resection of small pulmonary nodules, but intravascular migration is rare and potentially serious.

evidence.text: CT-guided microcoil localization facilitates minimally invasive resection of small pulmonary nodules, but intravascular migration is rare and potentially serious.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Systemic cardiac microcoil migration: A rare complication of CT-guided lung localization》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】With the patient supine, a 0.7 mm × 5 cm Visicoil marker was deployed once through a 10 cm, 18-gauge coaxial needle positioned 2.7 mm from the lesion.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】The asymptomatic patient had an unchanged coil projection on serial radiographs.

evidence.text: With the patient supine, a 0.7 mm × 5 cm Visicoil marker was deployed once through a 10 cm, 18-gauge coaxial needle positioned 2.7 mm from the lesion.
The asymptomatic patient had an unchanged coil projection on serial radiographs.
